abstract: ScalaHosting is a steady managed cloud host with 100% uptime in four independent tests. Entry Cloud renews at $39.95 a month, about 2.7 times the entry price, and there is no AI builder.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for sites that have outgrown shared hosting. Four independent tests recorded 100% uptime, and two measured a 29 ms P95 response under load.
Mini shared is $2.95 a month on a 1-year term. Entry Cloud is $11.21 a month on Black Friday and $39.95 standard.

mainEntity.name: How steep is the ScalaHosting renewal price increase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Entry Cloud renews at $39.95 a month, 3.6 times the $11.21 Black Friday price and 1.6 times the $24.95 three-year price.

mainEntity.name: What is the ScalaHosting uptime guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: ScalaHosting's homepage lists 99.9%, with a service credit as the stated remedy, according to DigitalPrahlad.

mainEntity.name: Does ScalaHosting have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ScalaHosting lists an anytime unconditional money-back guarantee on its homepage.
WPBeginner lists live chat, tickets and email. We did not find phone support listed.

mainEntity.name: Does ScalaHosting have data centers in Asia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its own data centers are in Dallas, New York and Sofia. HostScore measured 653 ms from Singapore.
ScalaHosting lists free site transfer. Check the limits when you order.
It lists SShield, AI-powered security. We found no AI site builder or assistant.
ScalaHosting is steadier under load and costs more. Hostinger is cheaper, with more AI tools.
SPanel is ScalaHosting's own control panel. It is an alternative to cPanel and includes Cloudflare CDN integration.
People who want built-in AI tools, the lowest price for years or phone support.
